# Chip

24px metadata chip — session city, timeframe, ACTIVE status.

```jsx
<Chip tone="accent" dot>ACTIVE</Chip>
<Chip tone="accent">London</Chip>
<Chip tone="neutral">5m</Chip>
```

- Status chips take `dot`; metadata chips do not.
- Uppercase for status, sentence case for city, lowercase for timeframe — copy the source exactly.
